text.description_html:
Push and Pull Handle Set

The Store Door Push and Pull Handle Set comes packaged as a set including one 9" Center to Center (CTC) offset door pull. It is made from 1" diameter solid brass round bar stock. Packaged with mounting hardware. Choose from polished brass or satin brass finishes.

Specifications for the Storedoor Push and Pull Handle Set:

  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Push Bar Diameter: 1"
  • Push Bar Center to Center (CTC): 33"
  • Packaged with Mounting Hardware

When Selecting the Pull Bar Length:

    DJO-191471:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 8"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-20147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 10"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-21147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 12"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-22147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 18"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-1156147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 8"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-1157147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 10"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"
    DJO-1158147:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 12"
    • Pull Diameter: 1"

*Sold as a Set (for 1 door). Made to order. NOT Returnable.
